preconditions.description: The length of the array is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element of the array is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (isinstance(return_value, list) and len(return_value) == m + 1 and all(isinstance(pair, tuple) and len(pair) == 2 for pair in return_value[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a list where the first element is the number of pairs and the subsequent elements are pairs of indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u < v <= n for u, v in return_value[1:])
postconditions.description: Each pair of indices is within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(a[u-1] > a[v-1] for u, v in return_value[1:])
postconditions.description: Each pair forms an inversion in the original array.

postconditions.expression: all((u, v) in return_value[1:] for u, v in inversions(a))
postconditions.description: All inversions in the array are included in the list.
After processing all pairs, the array is sorted in non-decreasing order.
